items.label: UPGRADED Remote Control
items.value: Experience the convenience and efficiency of remote controlled solar string lights. Enjoy 3 Brightness Levels (Soft/Bright/Super Bright), 3 Light Modes (Breathing/Flashing/Constant), and 4 Timer Settings (2/4/6/8 Hours). No need for extra timers or dimmers—elevate your outdoor ambiance with ease and precision

items.label: Solar & USB Charging Options
items.value: Be ready for anything with dual charging modes. Solar power harnesses the sun for up to 20+ hours of warm light after 8 hours in direct sunlight. Need a quick charge? The USB fast charge gets you fully powered in just 4 hours, ensuring your solar outdoor lights shine bright even on cloudy days

items.label: Shine Bright, No Matter What!
items.value: The string light is IP54 waterproof and designed to perform in rain, snow, or sunshine. However, The USB charging port is splash-resistant. To ensure long-term use, please keep the protective cover securely closed and avoid direct contact with water. The shatterproof PET bulbs can withstand drops and impacts, making them ideal for all-weather use

items.label: No outlets, no problem!
items.value: Our solar string lights come with a versatile stake and clip, allowing you to place the solar panel anywhere you choose. Suitable for all kinds of settings, including balconies, gardens, patios, pergolas, gazebos, tents, and more. Whether it’s a backyard BBQ, party, or enjoying a cozy outdoor camping trip, these solar string lights bring a warm, inviting glow to any occasion

items.label: addlon Promise
items.value: This 35FT solar string light set includes 11 shatterproof Edison-style bulbs (with 1 spare) for reliable performance and style. Backed by addlon’s 1-year quality support, If the wire is damaged or frayed, it may compromise the waterproof performance and pose a safety risk. Please stop using the lights immediately and contact us—we will replace them for you

items.label: Helpful Tips
items.value: For first-time use, please fully charge the lights using the USB port. While the string lights and solar panel are fully waterproof (IP54), the USB port are not submersible and should be protected from direct exposure to heavy rain. Do not use the lights if the wire is damaged or broken. A damaged cable may affect waterproofing and cause malfunction
